source_ref: McCullough, Emmons & Tsang (2002) GQ-6, canonical wording from pages.ucsd.edu/~memccullough/gratitude/ and ggsc.berkeley.edu/images/uploads/The_Gratitude_Questionnaire.pdf; item codes from PLOS ONE 10.1371/journal.pone.0247114 S1 Dataset (.s001, SPSS) via data/dudasova_2021_cpc12_battery.py
note: IDENTIFICATION IS RECONSTRUCTED, NOT SOURCED. The source paper (Dudasova et al. 2021, PLOS ONE 10.1371/journal.pone.0247114) never mentions gratitude at all -- the string 'gratitud' appears 0 times in the full JATS text -- and the gratitude block is one of several measures collected in the Study 1 teacher survey (N=282) but never reported. The S1 Dataset .sav (the URL in the IRW dictionary) carries NO item text: 103 columns, only 2 with any variable label ('REGR factor score 1/2 for analysis 1'), and zero value labels. S2/S3/S4 .sav files were also checked: 0, 0 and 1 label respectively, none on a gratitude column, and S4 has no Grat block. Dudasova's dissertation (theses.cz/id/133rjn) covers PsyCap, social support, engagement and life satisfaction only. So there is no study-side wording anywhere in the deposit or the paper. The instrument was identified structurally as the Gratitude Questionnaire-Six Item Form (GQ-6; McCullough, Emmons & Tsang 2002): six items, 1-7 agreement scale (live resp set is exactly 1..7), reverse-worded items at exactly positions 3 and 6 (see verification row). Wording transcribed from McCullough's own distributed copy (pages.ucsd.edu/~memccullough/gratitude/2-Page Blurb on the Gratitude Questionnaire.pdf), cross-checked character-by-character against the Greater Good Science Center copy (ggsc.berkeley.edu/images/uploads/The_Gratitude_Questionnaire.pdf); the two agree exactly apart from the UCSD PDF's typesetting artefact 'thank ful' in item 1 and its reverse-item asterisks. ONE DELIBERATE DEVIATION: the typographic apostrophe in item 3 (don’t) was written as an ASCII apostrophe. CODE DERIVATION: data/dudasova_2021_cpc12_battery.py melts the S1 columns by NAME (value_vars=['Grat1','Grat2','Grat3i','Grat4','Grat5','Grat6']), so the IRW item code IS the source column name -- no positional assignment and no rename. What is inferred is only which GQ-6 item each source column number refers to. REVERSE-CODING (affects option_text): across this .sav a trailing 'i' marks an already-recoded reverse item -- JS3i, Hope3i/5i/7i/11i and Perf14i-18i all show POSITIVE item-rest correlations despite being negatively-worded content. Grat3i follows that pattern (+0.41..+0.66 with the other five). Grat6 carries NO marker and correlates -0.35..-0.54 with every other item, i.e. it is the GQ-6's other reverse item stored RAW. option_text therefore runs 1='strongly disagree'..7='strongly agree' for five items and is REVERSED for Grat3i (1='strongly agree'..7='strongly disagree'), which is what the stored integers actually mean. Incidentally the .sav's own 'Grat' total column is the plain sum of the six columns as stored, i.e. it adds Grat6 un-reversed -- a scoring inconsistency in the authors' file, harmless here because the measure is never used in the paper. LANGUAGE: administered in Czech ('The survey was conducted in Czech'). No Czech wording exists in the deposit or the paper, so the 2026-09-01 fallback applies: canonical English in the base fields, language=Czech, _translated columns present but empty. instructions left blank deliberately: the GQ-6's printed instruction ('write a number beside each statement') describes a paper form, and this was an online survey, so shipping it would assert a prompt these respondents did not see. RIGHTS: no restriction found -- neither the UCSD nor the GGSC copy of the GQ-6 states a non-commercial, fee or no-redistribution term, and the source article is CC BY.
public_note: The source study never names or reports this gratitude measure and its data file carries no item labels, so the instrument was identified structurally as the GQ-6 and the wording shipped here is the canonical English GQ-6, not a string any respondent read -- the survey was administered in Czech and no Czech version is deposited. Note also that the stored values for Grat3i are already reverse-scored while Grat6 is stored raw, so Grat3i's response anchors run in the opposite direction to the other five items.
